message: 🚨 CRITICAL: All HTTPS traffic to api.example.com failing. SSL certificate expired.
Cert expired at midnight. Our auto-renewal cron job hasn't run. Checking why.
Found it. The cert renewal cron was running on the old infra box that was decommissioned last month during the cloud migration. Nobody moved the cron to the new infra.
Manually generating a new cert via Let's Encrypt now.
New cert generated and deployed. Waiting for propagation.
Traffic restored. Total downtime ~45 minutes. Need to set up cert renewal on the new infra and add expiry monitoring.
